## Requests for Comment (RFCs)

RFCs are design documents that propose significant changes to our systems and processes. They provide a consistent and controlled path for new features and architectural decisions.

### How it works

1. Copy `_template.qmd` into the appropriate project folder with the next sequence number
2. Fill in the template sections
3. Submit a pull request for review
4. Iterate based on feedback until the RFC is accepted or withdrawn
